name: Parr
role: Soldier, the same rank as Larry
summary: Photographed laughing beside Ron Tototz in VN-0025: "Ron Tototz on left and Parr who was same rank as me, probably PFC. After we landed he was Nha Trang with me." That was the first two months, about September and October 1964, when "they didn't know where to put us."
researchNotes: If Parr arrived on the same movement as Larry (September 1964), passenger manifests or morning reports from the arrival period could carry the name. The spelling is his son's rendering of the sound (Parr / Paar / Parrs). His first name, hometown and whether they stayed in touch are open (interview guide, tier 4). 2026-09-15, on his son's decision (no spelling notes on public pages): the rendered aliases were trimmed; removed from display, kept here: "Parr (phonetic)".
